description: Either party of a metered deal: close the payment channel on the ledger and record it; the unused rest returns to the buyer. The seller’s close is immediate; the buyer’s takes effect after the settle delay (or at once after the channel expires) — run it again then. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.
